items.task: Analysis round for core, no source change (decisions 0026 and 0027; second round: the six chains of the second level of the bisection were queued on 2026-11-22; the account's usage window is fresh). The six chains of ladder row 4 on the M/8 mesh (three models, each with its unkicked control; HANDOFF.md has the commands): close them (harness/bin/nrpic-run finish), classify each member by the rule written in the journal before the runs (collapse time, or the contraction against the control over 200 to 300 M), with figures looked at, and say whether the stability threshold is bracketed; queue the next level of the bisection as chains with the release card executable of core-v0.6 (predictions first; at most two jobs eligible, the rest behind them; at most twelve card-hours). Update the row-4 subsection and the ledger of the working note (tracks/core/note/), the stage package of G2 (collect, verify, report) and a plain statement of what G2 still lacks; answer Track A's request on the step limit and the knowledge base's request on the tests behind the paper-to-code links (inbox) as far as no source change is needed; STATUS.md, HANDOFF.md; commit; push core/nrpic. Also: read Track E's card smoke check of the branch executable of core/noise-level2 (tracks/E-stoch-inf/repro/ablation on branch track/E-stoch-inf: it is core's pending test T5) and record its outcome in tracks/core (a review of that branch on Fable runs beside you in worktree wt/core-s2: do not touch that worktree).

Source item for release v0.7: the step limit and the gauge speeds (tracks/core/interfaces/REQUESTS_WAVE3.md item W31 on core/nrpic; coord/DECISIONS/0027 item 2). Track A found by runs in which it could have failed that the Gamma-driver shift goes unstable at the grid scale once the step exceeds 0.685 of the cell (RK4 with Kreiss-Oliger dissipation 0.5; 0.65 on a 64-cell root mesh; 0.77 to 0.80 without dissipation), while <z4c> dt_lightspeed counts the speed of light only (z4c_newdt.cpp), and that the relaxed lapse is stiff where lapse_leak times the step is large (its request with run ids and the stability analysis: tracks/A-emd-pbh/outbox/20261121T231546Z__to-core__periodic-gamma-driver-step.md and package tracks/A-emd-pbh/periodic_diag on branch track/A-emd-pbh; its reproducing inputs diag_uniform there). Work: (1) derive the characteristic speeds of the gauge sector as the code evolves it (the Gamma-driver with its shift_Gamma and shift_eta, 1+log with the relaxation term) and the stability bound of the scheme for each (repeat A's von Neumann analysis with the code's stencils, RK4 and dissipation; say where you agree and where not); (2) implement the step limit that counts them (z4c_newdt.cpp), as an option, and decide by the evidence whether the old behaviour is a defect that should change by default (then it is a change without an option and the changelog says so) or stays the default for bit-identical old runs; a warning at start-up when the chosen cfl_number and gauge make the step exceed the bound, and when lapse_leak times the step is beyond its bound; (3) tests, predictions first (tracks/core/JOURNAL-step-limit.md): A's uniform-mesh reproducer at cfl_number 1.0 goes unstable without the new limit and stays smooth with it at the same cfl_number; A's refined periodic deck through the time of its failure; cost of the smaller step; byte regression against release core-v0.6 with the option absent; one card smoke run (at most half a card-hour); (4) interface text tracks/core/interfaces/step_limit.md; an outbox message to Track A with the executable and the option.

items.title: independent verifier for gate KB-G3
items.task: Independent verifier for gate KB-G3 of the knowledge base (coord/CHARTER.md section 'Gates of the knowledge base'; the lead asks for it: tracks/kb/HANDOFF.md, stage/REVIEW-wave3.md last section: read only the list of what is claimed, not the verdicts). Fresh reader, own code, predictions first, registered runs. (1) A stratified sample of sixty claims of packages claims_tracks and claims_brief (by track, by status fulltext/checked, located by machine, to_verify, judgement; seed committed before the draw), each re-read at its locator in the store (the snapshot db/current): statement supported, not supported, or locator wrong; the rate with its binomial interval. (2) The claims that refute a statement of the brief or of a track (for instance 742, 766, 767): each rederived from the source. (3) The bibliography of ingest3's twenty papers: ten cited keys per paper resolved by hand against the source. (4) The code index: ten parameter reads and ten paper-to-code links (kb/curated/paper_code_links.tsv) checked against the source at the indexed commit. (5) The parse rate recomputed by your own definition. tracks/kb/stage/KB-G3/VERIFIER.md: what was checked and how, per item CONFIRMED / NOT CONFIRMED / WRONG, what could not be checked, the three weakest points. Commit path-limited; push kb/main.

Add them to kb/manifests/arxiv_additions.tsv with group, requester and reason; ingest; the six old-style reference lists that ingest3 left (item, ref or refh paragraphs under a 'References' heading); QA (kb qa run) with the parse rate against the bar; answer each requesting track by an outbox message with locators. Predictions first; registered runs; the lead takes the snapshot (do not run kb snapshot); README.md; JOURNAL.md.
